resume_claim: On two Raspberry Pi 4s over direct 1 GbE, batched sustained 1.08x the processed UDP packet rate of recvfrom at <=0.1% application loss across all five repetitions under a 5 us per-packet processing budget; perf attributed the result to fewer receive syscalls and cycles per packet.

On two Raspberry Pi 4s over direct 1 GbE, threaded sustained 1.21x the processed UDP packet rate of recvfrom at <=0.1% application loss across all five repetitions under a 5 us per-packet processing budget; perf attributed the result to fewer receive syscalls per packet, with zero kernel ingress loss and zero queue overflow in every repetition.
